title: His Frozen Car Made Him Rich
description:
Marlo's car was frozen solid at 7 AM. No scraper, so he used his library card, and his boss docked him $50 for being late.

Watch how one frozen windshield turned into a million-dollar idea, the night 200 cars froze and his scraper snapped, and why MegaSock's defrost drones couldn't compete.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).
